name: sarwa
description: Tharwa workspace — run dev from here to start API + admin + website together

scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix backend-api --no-audit --no-fund && npm install --prefix admin-dashboard --no-audit --no-fund && npm install --prefix website --no-audit --no-fund
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,admin,web -c blue,green,cyan "npm run dev --prefix backend-api" "npm run dev --prefix admin-dashboard" "npm run dev --prefix website"
